description: Figure: family-wide Phobius predictions, insertion free energies, and conservation of burial versus loss of hydrophobicity between S. pombe ahk1 and its S. cryophilus ortholog
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
P=pd.read_csv("phobius_family_sample.csv")
T=pd.read_csv("ortholog_structural_comparison.csv")
dg = {"ahk1 277-297":1.489,"ahk1 374-394":3.349,"ahk1 400-420":2.158,
      "S.cryo 254-274":4.559,"ScAhk1 123-143":3.565,
      "pma1 TM3":-3.008,"trk1 TM3":-1.480,"pkd2 TM2":3.401}
json.dump(dg, open("dgpred_results.json","w"))
P.to_csv("phobius_family_sample.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,8.5))

a=ax[0,0]
vc=P.nTM.value_counts().sort_index()
a.bar(vc.index, vc.values, color="#7a8894")
a.bar([3],[1],color="#c2185b")
for x,y in zip(vc.index,vc.values): a.text(x,y+0.8,str(y),ha="center",fontsize=9)
a.set_xticks([0,1,2,3]); a.set_xlabel("Phobius-predicted transmembrane helices")
a.set_ylabel("number of proteins")
a.set_title(f"PF08578 / UPF0592 family, n={len(P)} sampled members\nahk1 (pink) is the only member called 3-TM")

a=ax[0,1]
labs=list(dg.keys()); vals=[dg[k] for k in labs]
cols=["#c2185b"]*3+["#8e44ad","#8e44ad"]+["#1f6fb4"]*3
a.barh(range(len(labs))[::-1], vals, color=cols)
a.axvline(0,color="k",lw=1)
a.set_yticks(range(len(labs))[::-1]); a.set_yticklabels(labs,fontsize=9)
a.set_xlabel("predicted insertion free energy, dG (kcal/mol)")
a.set_title("dgpred (Hessa biological hydrophobicity scale)\nnegative = favours Sec61 insertion")
a.text(0.98,0.04,"blue = real TM helices\npink = ahk1 segments\npurple = ortholog segments",
       transform=a.transAxes,ha="right",fontsize=8)

a=ax[1,0]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.38
a.bar(x-w/2, T.pombe_rsa, w, color="#c2185b", label="S. pombe ahk1")
a.bar(x+w/2, T.cryo_rsa, w, color="#8e44ad", label="S. cryophilus S9W252")
a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels(T.seg)
a.set_ylabel("mean relative solvent accessibility")
a.set_title("Same segments, same burial in both species\n(identity in segments 62-76% vs 45.8% genome-wide)")
a.legend(fontsize=9)

a=ax[1,1]
a.bar(x-w/2, T.pombe_charged, w, color="#c2185b", label="S. pombe ahk1")
a.bar(x+w/2, T.cryo_charged, w, color="#8e44ad", label="S. cryophilus S9W252")
a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels(T.seg)
a.set_ylabel("charged residues (D, E, K, R) per 21 aa")
a.set_title("The sister species tolerates charges inside the segments\n(Phobius calls 0 TM in S. cryophilus)")
a.legend(fontsize=9)
for i,(p_,c_) in enumerate(zip(T.pombe_seq,T.cryo_seq)):
    a.text(i, max(T.pombe_charged[i],T.cryo_charged[i])+0.15, f"{p_}\n{c_}", ha="center", fontsize=6, family="monospace")
a.set_ylim(0,5.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
